purpose: Bounded SECURITY DEFINER capability that atomically establishes or idempotently replays one self-owned Activity or Event Schedule using an activated Schedule placement form while preserving one stable Schedule identity and explicit current-history semantics.

routine.return_type: TABLE(subject_native_ref uuid, schedule_ref uuid, material_state_ref uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Creates one immutable placement MaterialState in the requested activated form and reuses that exact effect on valid idempotent replay.
state_history.current_binding: The same transaction establishes the explicit current binding to the accepted placement.
state_history.chronology: The same authoritative timestamp records the initial current-history episode and immutable operation receipt.
state_history.immutability_policy: Different intent under the same operation id conflicts; replay cannot overwrite canonical Schedule truth.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: Migration-only capability removal; downgrade fails closed when Schedule history depends on it.

obligations: function owner is dante_owner and SECURITY DEFINER is enabled
runtime EXECUTE is granted while PUBLIC and dante_migrator EXECUTE are denied
only typed self-owned Activity or Event subjects are admitted
Schedule placement forms preserve exact accepted semantics without collapsing owner identity
Schedule, typed placement, explicit current binding, current-history episode and receipt commit atomically
same operation and same intent replay while changed intent conflicts
no Event-specific Schedule engine is introduced
